name: Financial Assistance to 75% or Permanent Disability
benefit: - Financial assistance of ₹2,00,000/- is provided by the Board to the registered worker for 75% or more permanent disability.
_eligibility_text: 1. The worker must be engaged in building or construction work. 1. The worker should be registered under the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW). 1. The worker should have a 75% or permanent disability.
